title: The Hanging Office
kicker: A treehouse-office counterweighted by a rune-marked boulder and full of forms, runes, plants, and magic.
hook: A treehouse-office counterweighted by a rune-marked boulder and full of forms, runes, plants, and magic.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The Hanging Office creaks above the ground like a joke told by someone exhausted from surviving it.
